# Branch 2.0.0 (vendored)

`Branch.rbxm` is the prebuilt runtime of Branch, a Roblox game framework by realllity / PraxPrix Studios (MIT, see
`LICENSE`). Source: https://github.com/PraxPrix-Studios/Branch-Framework at commit
5efbcd6bce81515aeb3ab3b333dbc105d55bc55a (2026-09-26).

`scripts/steps/post_branch_framework.luau` places it at `ReplicatedStorage.Packages.Branch`. Steal a Hero uses its
segment loader for the systems added since 2026-09-27:
- server: `ServerScriptService.BranchServer` starts `ServerScriptService.Services` (`*Service` modules);
- client: `StarterPlayerScripts.BranchClient` starts `StarterPlayerScripts.Controllers` (`*Controller` modules).

Not used on purpose:
- `Branch.Data` (ProfileStore). The game keeps its own `Library.Database` so existing player saves are untouched.
- `Branch.Network`. It is generated by the Branch Studio plugin, which only runs inside Studio. Once the plugin has
  compiled it into the place, remotes can move over to it.
